slides.title: WebSocket Protocol
slides.prompt: WebSockets provide persistent, full-duplex communication channels over a single TCP connection.
slides.codeSnippet:
import asyncio
import websockets

async def handler(websocket):
    data = await websocket.recv()
    await websocket.send(f'Echo: {data}')
